title: Movers in Megenagna: Complete Relocation Guide (2026)
excerpt: Megenagna moving guide: Yeka traffic, Shola and Kotebe staging, condo lifts near the junction, and professional movers for east Addis Ababa relocations.
content:
Moving in Megenagna and east Addis Ababa

Megenagna is one of the busiest junctions in Addis Ababa—connecting Yeka, Bole-bound traffic, and routes toward CMC and Kotebe. Moves here succeed when you plan time of day, building access, and truck staging before the crew arrives. Active Movers serves Megenagna, Shola, Kotebe, and surrounding condos every week.

Traffic and best windows

  • Morning rush (roughly 7:00–9:30) and evening rush (17:00–19:30) slow trucks on the Megenagna corridor.
  • Mid-morning or early afternoon on weekdays often load faster if your building allows it.
  • Saturday mornings work when compound management permits weekend freight—book lifts early in the month.

Shola, Kotebe, and side-street staging

Many addresses advertised as “Megenagna” sit on Shola side streets or deeper Kotebe blocks where trucks cannot wait on the main junction. Crews legally stage one block off the arterial and hand-carry 30–80 meters. Your walkthrough should measure carry distance and elevator size—imported wardrobes often need disassembly when service lifts are under 2 meters wide.

Condominiums and apartments

High-rise and mid-rise condos dominate Yeka. Confirm move permits, freight or service lift slots, and security ID lists 24–48 hours ahead. Two households moving the same weekend in one tower should coordinate with management to avoid overlapping elevator bookings—see our Shola–Megenagna corridor guide.

Cross-district routes

Common legs include Megenagna to CMC, inner Bole, Sarbet, or Lemi Kura (Ayat). Quotes reflect distance plus crew time in traffic and double building access (move-out and move-in). One full truck beats shuttling with small pickups that multiply gate fees.

Office and shop moves

Small offices and clinics near the junction often move after 18:00 or on Sunday when freight is allowed. IT racks and filing cabinets need labeled boxes—include them in inventory so crew size is right the first time.

Corridor construction

Ring-road and feeder upgrades sometimes detour trucks away from usual staging points. Check traffic and gate notices the week before moving day and share updates with your Active Movers coordinator.

Pricing and booking

Typical condo moves start from the tiers on our 2026 cost guide and homepage price table. Stair carry applies when no freight lift is available. Schedule your Megenagna move · Local moving services

Yeka sub-city context

Megenagna sits inside Yeka—addresses vary from junction towers to deep Kotebe drives. Read the Yeka overview when your compound name does not match “Megenagna” on the lease.

Group moves and deposits

Two neighbors in one tower should book one vendor when management prefers single freight days—group discounts. Elevator deposits and permit fees stay with you per building rules; the mover follows the booked slot.

Truck timing alignment

Legal truck windows and lift reservations must match—see freight timing guide. School zones along Shola add delay; plan load-out after 9:30 when possible.
